_not: SÜRÜM NOTLARI (Ömer 2026-10-11): ana menüde sağ alttaki sürüm yazısına dokununca açılan Patch Notes penceresi (src/ui/patch-notes.ts). En yeni sürüm en üstte. Her sürüm: version, date (YYYY-MM-DD) ve ya 'items' (düz satırlar) ya da 'groups' ({ heading: New | Changes | Fixes, items }). Satırlar KISA, oyuncuya yönelik, sade İngilizce; dosya adı / iç terim yok. Sürüm kuralı (Ömer 2026-10-11): küçük güncelleme (tek skill ayarı, hata düzeltme, arayüz değişikliği, performans) ALT sürüm alır: 0.6.11 -> 0.6.11.1 -> 0.6.11.2 (package.json 0.6.11 kalır); büyük güncelleme üçüncü sayıyı artırır (0.6.12, package.json da); ara sürümleri (0.7.0) Ömer söyler; yalnızca taslak (mockup) paylaşımı sürüm ve not ALMAZ. Ekranda görünen sürüm EN ÜSTTEKİ girdidir (vite.config.ts > __DISPLAY_VERSION__, src/ui/display-version.ts). tests/patch-notes.test.ts: en üstteki sürüm = package.json sürümü ya da onun '.N' alt sürümü.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: Windy Moor, Iron Pass and Charcoal Camp are easier.
The in-game Menu is slightly see-through.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Phones: heroes and enemies no longer turn invisible after several battles.
Equip best and dragging no longer put a dagger in the off-hand while the main hand is empty.
Campaign map: fog no longer covers the stops you can travel to.
Phones: with Valor in battle, the Combat log button stays on screen.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: every enemy after Ashford is 5% weaker in health and damage.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Ruined Watchtower: the Bandit Chief has slightly less health and hits a little softer.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Merchant on phones: a Buy back tab lets you buy back what you sold during this visit.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: your first hero is a Warrior or an Archer; all classes open up when you form your company in Ashford.
Ravenwood: the companion offered depends on your first hero.
Tutorial battles are a little tougher.

groups.heading: New
items: Garrick teaches more: hit chance, reading a fighter, helping allies, fallen heroes, wounds, the road, rest camps and item quality.
First battle: a second guided turn shows your stronger MP skill, and the screen dims around what the mentor points at.
Settings > Gameplay: Replay tutorials plays every lesson again.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: the first battles after Ashford are easier, so the step up from the tutorial is smoother.
Campaign: Ravenwood and the Ruined Watchtower are a little tougher again; later regular fights are slightly harder.

groups.heading: New
items: Garrick, your tutorial mentor, has his own portrait.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign: Retreat to Map now pauses the battle. Return to that stop to resume from the same turn; the road and gear stay locked until then.
Campaign: enemies after Ashford are slightly tougher.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: First battle: buttons the mentor is not asking for are greyed out, and the mentor's box shakes if you press one.
Merchant: tapping outside the welcome card opens the shop.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Endless: the Revive reward card is gone; fallen heroes return with Valor, Resurrection or Raise Dead. Enemies grow a bit slower per wave.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Endless: Retreat to Camp no longer restarts the wave; the battle stays paused and resumes where you left it.

groups.heading: New
items: Tutorial lessons now appear only when they matter, and point at the button to use right then.
Hits feel different by strength: light flinch, normal hit, or a heavy knockback with dust.
New painted Valor braziers, shown small at the top left next to Back.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Back, Menu and fullscreen are matching icon buttons in one row; fullscreen is available on every screen size.
Smaller tutorial box on phones; the first battles are easier.
Merchant and Gear screens fit phones: no overlap, full stat names, whole bag rows.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Arriving at Ashford no longer freezes the game; stuck saves continue normally.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: The loading screen now turns sideways with the game when a phone is held upright.

groups.heading: New
items: New logo, app icon and loading screen.
Campaign tutorial: Commander Garrick teaches one thing at a time; turn it off in Settings or with Don't show again.
Codex Lessons: reread every tutorial lesson you have seen. Endless shows a short intro the first time.
Music for the map, town, battles, bosses and the Endless camp, plus parchment, book, coin, gear and battle horn sounds.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Heroes stand in a narrower stance, keep each item in the same hand and hold edged weapons point up.
Hands come down right after a skill lands instead of hanging in the air.
Fewer hint texts on screens; the Back button no longer shows an Esc tag.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: You can enter Ashford again after leaving it.

groups.heading: New
items: Valor: wins light embers in two braziers; spend them to revive a fallen hero, in battle or between battles.
Heroes now fight with full animated poses and show the weapon they wield.
New moves: Cutthroat crosses both daggers for Saltire Cut; the Hexer pins her doll for Doom Mark; Archer aims high for Arrow Rain.
The three new shields have their own icons.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign enemies hit harder to match Valor.
Endless: two foes every wave; each boss is tougher than the last.
Fire Bolt, Nature's Wrath and Void Strike cost 1 more MP.
Card Trick's cards are smaller.

groups.heading: New
items: New battle backgrounds for every campaign region, King's Bridge and the Castle Hall; new town art.
Campaign enemies have their own looks: thugs, crossbowmen, ember acolytes, fen witchlings, ghouls, shieldwardens, wisps and more.
Three new shields; Settings now has a separate Sound Effects volume.
Map: click a stop to march there; battles ask before they start; hover a stop to see who waits there.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Each gear slot now has its own kind of stats (weapons hit, armor protects, boots move, trinkets sustain).
Stats that reach their limit are marked MAX; only two copies of the same top-tier affix count.
Hexer: Doom takes 4 turns; skills hit harder and Doom a little softer; Doom Mark deals 10% more. Omens no longer jump on from a Doom kill.
Party picking uses the same drag-and-drop everywhere; the Codex no longer lists test characters.

groups.heading: New
items: Campaign battles now have their own backgrounds for every region of Valdoria.
Towns open as a full scene: visit the stall, the notice board, the locals and the campfire.
Menus are centered with icons.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Debug: Pose Tester skills now use fitting poses; spells and arrows leave from the weapon.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: New campaign setup no longer replays its animation on every click.

groups.heading: New
items: Debug: 11 Pose Testers try every class's skills with the new poses and weapons.
New weapon art: maces, daggers, staves, bows, shields, charms, great axes and mauls.

groups.heading: Changes
items: A two-handed weapon shows a faded copy in the Off-hand slot.
Warrior's Rage now sits in line with HP and MP.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Statuses like Omen now appear when the skill lands, not when it is cast.

groups.heading: New
items: New Off-hand slot: carry a shield or a second dagger next to a one-handed weapon.
Weapons now show whether they are one-handed, two-handed, a bow or a charm.
Valdren Keep: convince the commander and he shares how to beat the Bridge Warden.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Witch's Hut deals now give one item and a little gold.
Windy Moor, Iron Pass and Charcoal Camp fight a little harder; Hard is tougher.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Gifts show as a Gift on the spoils card.

groups.heading: New
items: Campaign: new enemy families (bandits, Ember Cult, guardians, hexes, undead) on the roads from Windy Moor to Misty Marsh.
Witch's Hut and Shepherd's Fold now offer choices.
Towns have a merchant and a short story scene; talk to the charcoal burner in Ashford.
Codex: a new Enemies section.
Version 0.7: everything from 0.6.10 to 0.6.14.1 in one release.
Campaign: new Valdoria map, Rest camps, merchants, fallen heroes and a full rebalance.
Items: affix tiers, rare drops, 18 Legendary items with their own icons.
Touch: one tap opens an item; Gear and the campaign map are cleaner.
Campaign: elite fights are a little easier, bosses a little harder.

groups.heading: New
items: Campaign: fallen heroes stay down after battle; revive them at Rest camps or in town.
Towns now fully heal and revive your whole company for free.
Shepherd's Fold offers a rest after its event.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Campaign rebalanced: regular and elite enemies are weaker, heroes heal 25% after each win.
Legendary items now roll at the level of the place they drop.
Campaign map: tap a road to see it, tap again to march; road info sits under your party.
Gear slots show only the item name; touch: one tap opens an item, with Equip, Buy or Sell buttons.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Old character art removed from the game files and the Codex.
All 18 Legendary items now have their own hand-painted icons.
Codex updated: a new Endless article, item affixes and rarity rolls, rare drops, battle speed and the new bar regen display.
Codex status pages now show which Legendary items apply Burning and Fleet.

groups.heading: New
items: Valdoria's map is redrawn and longer, with a Rest camp and a merchant stop on the road.
Rest camps heal your company for free; fallen heroes can be revived there for gold.
Zoom the campaign map with the mouse wheel or a pinch.
Debug: Pose Tester I and II try other classes' skills with the new poses.

groups.heading: Changes
items: The Gear skill bar now matches the battle skill bar.
Merchant: Wares and Character are tabs; Odo shows all stats of today's pick.
Old campaign saves must restart because the map changed.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Combat log no longer mixes the next turn's healing or damage into the previous action.

groups.heading: New
items: The Warrior now moves through real poses: slashes, a spinning Whirlwind, a war cry.
The Warrior's weapon shows the sword or axe he has equipped.
Lucky Escape plays its own moment: the blow glances off and a lucky horseshoe flips.
Debug: a pose tester to try every Warrior pose and weapon.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Turn-start healing and mana no longer float over heads; the bars glow instead.
Battle numbers no longer overlap each other.
The in-game menu is a bit larger; the main menu music fades in gently.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Fighters no longer float above the floor in the castle hall; battles use less memory.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Codex asset pages open about twice as fast.
Returning to the main menu no longer stutters while the music restarts.
Less background work on every screen, for smoother play on phones.

groups.heading: New
items: Gear is split into a Character page and an Inventory page; the bag is the same everywhere.
Item tooltips follow the cursor, and hero cards show what an item would change for them.
Equip by dragging or double-clicking; drag to the trash to discard.
Odo welcomes you, and the reward screen has a View bag button.
Tap the version number to read these patch notes.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Rarer items roll stronger bonuses; Endless items keep growing with the wave.
Settings section titles are easier to tell apart.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Mana Steal no longer drains mana when the attack misses, is dodged or is saved by Lucky Escape.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Items reworked: rarity now means more bonus stats, and item power grows with item level.
Eight new Legendary items.
One shared loot table for campaign rewards, Endless rewards and the merchant.
Your saves are updated to the new item system automatically.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Status badges on phones no longer overlap: the most important ones come first, the rest show as +N.
Clearer rarity frames on merchant cards.
Smoother fade when leaving the in-game Menu.

groups.heading: New
items: Performance mode in Settings (Auto, On, Off) for slower phones.
Show FPS option in Settings.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Battles run much smoother, especially on phones.
Switching between skills reacts faster.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Settings now has a Sounds section: Master Volume, Music and UI sounds.
Every slider has 20 steps: volumes from 0 to 100%, battle speed from 0.25x to 4x.
The menu music starts right after your first click or tap.
Endless: enemies grow stronger a little more slowly each wave.

groups.heading: New
items: Main menu music: a medieval tune with lute, flute, drone and frame drum.
The game version is shown in the main menu corner. Tap it to read these notes.
Battle speed setting: shorter or longer pauses between turns.
Gear shows your hero's skills, and how each item changes their numbers.

groups.heading: Changes
items: Endless: the battlefield stays between waves, and fallen heroes can be revived with a reward card.
Speed bars fill up between turns so you can see who acts next.
Stat tips in Gear and at the merchant show what goes up (green) and down (red).

groups.heading: New
items: Legendary items: one unique item per hero, with rare drops after victories.
Painted art for every item, status and map icon.
Endless: pick and arrange your company with drag and drop.

groups.heading: Changes
items: The same debuff no longer stacks: casting it again refreshes it.
Endless: open your bag from the reward screen; items are no longer sold automatically.
Medieval sounds for menus and buttons, with their own volume.
The game loads faster.

groups.heading: New
items: Animated main menu: a burning Valdoria at dusk, with smoke, embers and crows.
Reduced motion setting for a calmer menu.
New battle look with a slimmer bar, and the merchant Odo the Peddler in Endless.
New art for the Campaign, Quick Battle and Multiplayer cards, and new Defender effects.

groups.heading: Fixes
items: Multiplayer: Rematch no longer blocks the other buttons and can be cancelled.
